name: @neo-angband/core
description: Headless Neo Angband game engine: rules, world, entities, effects, generation
author: neostryder (RPGM Tools)
//files: This engine keeps its 248 test modules beside its 485 source modules in src/,
not in a tests/ tree, so a bare `dist` would publish 248 compiled test files
that import vitest - a dependency this package does not declare and a consumer
does not have. The negations drop them, and tools/check-npm-package.mjs runs
`npm pack` and FAILS if one survives; a `files` list is a claim, and the
src/ ships on purpose: the .js.map files point into it, so a stack trace out of
the engine lands on real TypeScript instead of nowhere.
